title: Enrollment and Retail Series
description: A reference-driven back-to-school campaign system that locks school-reset energy and extends it across retail and enrollment variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a bright academic-retail world built from stationery order, locker or desk cues, campus energy, and family-ready retail polish; images 02-04 preserve that exact language while moving through age tiers, tech bundles, and enrollment-fair display.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-campus-desk-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-starter-kit-variation, 03-tech-bundle-variation, 04-enrollment-fair-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-campus-desk-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
